page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs, operating with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to the dedicated CPU allocation and a low memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is structured for compute-heavy workloads that do not require large memory footprints. Qualitative cost efficiency is centered on high CPU density relative to memory capacity. Appropriate workloads include parallel processing tasks, batch computing, and lightweight web serving where CPU execution speed is prioritized over memory capacity.
